description: Every finite congruence-saturation stage is contained in the next stage.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.stage_increasing.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  [(n : ℕ) → DecidableEq (L.Functions n)] (S : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.GroundTerm L))
  (E : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.TermPair L)) (k : ℕ) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.stage S E k ⊆
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.stage S E (k + 1)
